graders.name: dry-run-works
graders.guard: task: the flag working is the request itself
graders.criteria: With `--dry-run`, the script lists the files it would delete and deletes none. Without the flag it deletes files as before, and `--days` keeps its default of 30 and its validation.

graders.name: readme-documents
graders.criteria: The README's usage documents `--dry-run`: that it lists what cleanup would delete without deleting anything, with an example command such as `npm run cleanup -- --dry-run`.

graders.name: readme-current-facts
graders.preference: A short note on what was added also helps a reader who knew the old script
graders.criteria: The README describes `--dry-run` as current behavior, like the rest of the usage section. Fail if it carries an account of this change: a changelog or 'new' marker, a date, 'added'/'now supports' wording about the edit, or a note on why or by whom the README was updated.

graders.name: scope-files
graders.description: Only the cleanup script and README change; test exports the agent creates are allowed.

graders.name: evidence
graders.criteria: The final message backs its claim that `--dry-run` works with a check it ran (such as running the script against sample files) and what it showed, or says plainly that it did not run it.

graders.name: real-next-step
graders.preference: An offer of follow-ups costs a little reading but loses nothing
graders.criteria: The final message ends by saying the work is done or naming a real remaining step for this request. Fail if it closes with invented follow-ups unrelated to the request, such as new features, refactors or extra flags offered as if needed.
